# The arena's art: the prompts for ChatGPT (v2.3.3730)

<!-- GENERATED by tools/world/arena-art-prompts.mjs: edit the script, then run it. -->

The pictures the owner made for the arena, each from a prompt the Object Studio's own builder made (`public/tools/objects/prompts.js` `promptFor`), with the style key attached. The pictures that came back are kept in `assets/prop-source/arena/`; `tools/world/add-arena-art.mjs` cuts them into the game's art (`docs/specs/arena-art.md`).

These entries are not in the Object Studio's catalog (`public/tools/objects/catalog.js`): a catalog change re-bakes both Wheels and deploys the worker, and this art comes into the game through `src/data/arenaArt.js` instead.

## Rodeo ring

- **Kept as:** `assets/prop-source/arena/ring.png`
- **Cut into:** `public/world/arena/ring-back.png` and `ring-front.png`, 640 x 357.5 game px whole (the far rails behind fighters, the near rails in front) (`docs/specs/arena-art.md`)
- **Asked for:** one object, the widest 640 game px wide, on a wide 3:2 picture

```text
A wide picture (3:2, landscape) of ONE object for BroTown, a top-down 2D action RPG: a big round rodeo ring for duels, seen from above at a steep angle so the circle looks like a wide oval: a ring of sturdy log posts joined by three split-log rails all the way round, enclosing open, empty ground, with a wide gap at the front where the entrance is. The ground inside and outside the ring is the background colour, not dirt or grass. A few posts are proudly patched, one rail is held on with rope, and a horseshoe is nailed to one post for luck. It is drawn whole in the middle of the picture, with plenty of background all round and nothing cut off. It stands on nothing: no ground, grass, path or shadow under or around it, and the place where it meets the ground is plain to see. Built and used by Bros: well made, a little battered, with a proud repair or a dent here and there.

No text, letters or numbers anywhere. The background is ONE flat magenta colour (#FF00FF) everywhere, with no shading, gradient, texture, shadow or glow, so it can be cut away cleanly. Nothing in the picture is magenta or bright pink. No border.

Style: BroTown HD pixel art: crisp, modern high-definition pixel art on one clean square pixel grid, like Eastward or Sea of Stars. Every pixel is a hard-edged square: no blur, no anti-aliasing, no soft brushes and no smooth gradients. Each colour is shaded with 3 to 5 flat tones, in clusters of pixels rather than single stray ones, with shadows shifted toward cool blue-purple and highlights toward warm yellow. Every material is drawn as itself, so it can be told apart at a glance by its own texture and the shape of its highlights: grass in soft clumps of blades, packed earth with a few small stones, stone with hard-edged facets, chips and cracks, wood with grain lines and knots, metal with small, sharp, bright highlights, snow and ice in cool blues with crisp edges, and sand in soft, fine drifts. Texture comes from a few clear shapes and soft shading, never from noise, speckle or grain. Highlights are small clusters of pixels, never single stray ones. Soft, even daylight from the upper left. No shadows cast on the ground, and no glow, fog or lighting effects: the game adds those. The ground has no outlines. Anything that stands up has a one-pixel outline in a darker shade of its own colour, never black, lighter on the sunlit side. Moderate saturation, with the ground calm and mid-toned so characters stand out. Seen from a steep three-quarter top-down angle, with no perspective.

Attached is the game's style key. Match its pixel size, colours, shading and the way it draws each material exactly, but do not copy its tiles. Scale: a person standing here would be about one fifth as tall as this picture. It is about six times as wide as a person is tall, so it fills about four fifths of the picture's width.
```
